# firezone_group_membership (Resource)

Manages group membership (actors in a group). This resource manages the complete list of members for a group.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `actor_ids` (Set of String) Set of actor IDs that are members of this group
- `group_id` (String) Group ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Membership resource ID (same as group_id)
